references.text: The context for the Sabbath year for the land, explaining what the Sabbath of the earth entails and what grows on its own.
The continuation which includes that even the animals shall eat from the land's produce in the Sabbath year.
Earlier law concerning the Sabbath year where the poor and the animals shall eat from what grows in the field.
The Sabbath year as a year of release, where debts are forgiven and slaves are freed.
The command to treat foreigners as natives, relevant for the reference to 'your foreigner who lives among you'.
Refers to the hired worker (שָׂכִיר) and the foreigner, the same groups mentioned in the verse.
Jesus teaches about God's care for food and life, parallel to God's provision through the Sabbath year.
